scope: Core nearby communication regression after keeping presentation tools disabled by default

environment.media: Local SFU using synthetic browser devices

tests.name: mobile and desktop participants exchange microphone and camera RTP over the SFU
a screen source restriction stops shared video and audio together
three peers: crossing the meeting-room boundary revokes outside receivers and never reshares the screen automatically
untouched media windows migrate to a screen-first, camera-visible layout

summary: 4/4 focused E2E checks passed. Microphone/camera RTP, screen video/audio authorization, private-room boundary cleanup, and the camera-visible screen-share layout remain functional.
limitations: Synthetic Chromium capture devices do not verify physical phone hardware, mobile operating-system permissions, public TURN routing, or production network capacity.
